task_input: Review my local changes before I push. Start by checking the scope and then inspect the actual diff.
expected_behavior: A good response should gather scope with git diff/log, inspect the diff, and return structured findings rather than guessing.

rubric_checks.description: Uses git diff stat for scope
Uses git log for commit context
